b2-12-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Work Still to Be Done
b2-12-01.scenario: Evila (you are Berend Iván) asks in your laboratory what is still waiting for the team before the test in the mine.
b2-12-01.prompt: Tell Evila what tasks are still waiting for the team.
cues: Say that tasks are still waiting
b2-12-01.target: Még sok sürgős, megoldandó feladat vár a csapatra.
b2-12-01.english: Many urgent tasks to be solved are still waiting for the team.
b2-12-01.canDo: I can form the obligatory/future participle using -andó (back vowels) and -endő (front vowels)

b2-12-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How We Stop the Fire
b2-12-02.scenario: Evila (you are Berend Iván) asks how you will deal with the fire in the Bondavölgy mine.
b2-12-02.prompt: Tell Evila by what means you will solve the problem.
b2-12-02.target: Az új eljárás révén és az új berendezés segítségével oldjuk meg a problémát.
b2-12-02.english: We solve the problem by means of the new procedure and with the help of the new equipment.
b2-12-02.canDo: I can express formal instrumentality, channel, and agency using révén, útján, segítségével, and által

b2-12-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why a New Machine
b2-12-03.scenario: Evila (you are Berend Iván) wants to know why the new machine is being built for the Bondavölgy mine.
b2-12-03.prompt: Tell Evila why you are building the new machine.
cues: Give the purpose of the machine
b2-12-03.target: A tűz elfojtása céljából és a bányászok biztonsága érdekében csináljuk az új gépet.
b2-12-03.english: We are making the new machine for the purpose of suppressing the fire and in the interest of the miners' safety.
b2-12-03.canDo: I can express technical purpose and functional specifications using nominalized verbal nouns (-ás/-és) + céljából, érdekében, and végett

b2-12-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Test
b2-12-04.scenario: Evila (you are Berend Iván) asks whether anything can still go wrong before the test in the mine.
b2-12-04.prompt: Tell Evila what still has to be dealt with before the test.
cues: Say what helps to deal with it
b2-12-04.target: A próba előtt még az új gép segítségével elhárítandó hibaforrás van.
b2-12-04.english: Before the test there is still a source of error to be dealt with using the new machine.
b2-12-04.canDo: I can build complex prenominal modifier chains combining postpositional phrases with -andó/-endő participles

b2-12-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Plan for the Mine
b2-12-05.scenario: Evila listens while you, Berend Iván, present your plan for saving the Bondavölgy mine.
b2-12-05.prompt: Present your plan to Evila in two sentences.
cues: Name the problem to be solved
Say how and why you will act
b2-12-05.target: A megoldandó probléma a tűz. Az új eljárás révén és a bányászok védelme érdekében dolgozunk.
b2-12-05.english: The problem to be solved is the fire. We work by means of the new procedure and in the interest of protecting the miners.
b2-12-05.canDo: I can synthesize obligatory participles (-andó/-endő) and formal postpositions (révén, útján, segítségével, céljából, érdekében) in an innovation pitch

b2-12-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summary for the Mine
b2-12-consolidation.scenario: Evila asks you, Berend Iván, to sum up for the miners what has been decided about the mine.
b2-12-consolidation.prompt: Sum up in two sentences what is still to be done and why.
cues: Name a task still to be done
Give the purpose and the means
b2-12-consolidation.target: A sürgősen elvégzendő munkát az új gép segítségével csináljuk. A bányászok biztonsága érdekében dolgozunk.
b2-12-consolidation.english: We do the urgently needed work with the help of the new machine. We work in the interest of the miners' safety.
b2-12-consolidation.canDo: I can form and use the obligatory participle (-andó/-endő) across back-vowel, front-vowel, and irregular stems
